name: Dreaded Shape (General)
body:
“See now the shape of fear”

Prerequisite(s): Change shape (form of the dragon III) and moment of change class feature,

Benefit(s): If you spend one moment of change, you become a larger, awful version of your current shape. You grow to size Large, and take on features that horrify your enemies. You gain the following abilities for one round per taskshaper class level you possess: a +6 size bonus to Strength, a +4 size bonus to Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus, DR 10/cold iron or silver (your choice), and spell resistance equal to 10 + your taskshaper class level. You also emit an aura that emanates 30 feet from you. Enemy creatures within the aura are shaken. Each time a creature shaken by this aura hits you with a melee attack, that creature becomes frightened for 1d4 rounds, though at the end of that duration it is no longer affected by this aura. The aura’s effect is a fear and mind-affecting effect.

Special: You can take this feat as a shaped capacity so long as you meet its prerequisites.
